messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: How can I find the effect size of the (standardised) regression coefficients?
parts: How can I find the effect size of the significant relations in this sample?

A slope is an effect size, and the standardized slope is a standardized measure of effect size (albeit questionable because sample-specific statistics are used to "standardize", so they may not map onto population parameters).  The "std.all" column shows you what the slopes would be if both the predictor and outcome had total variances of 1.
